title: The Attack Surface Is the Architecture | A Cinematic Research Brief
base_title: The Attack Surface Is the Architecture
description:
The risk in agent systems is not just the model. It is the architecture you wrapped around it and all the boundaries it quietly opened.

This cinematic brief frames safety as an architectural problem, not a last-mile policy layer pasted on after the system already has too many unsafe degrees of freedom.

It should attract viewers who need a more operational model of agent safety than red-team spectacle alone.
